summary_zh: 颗粒材料展现出复杂且高度可变的相互作用动力学特性，这使得在缺乏其物理属性知识的情况下，对其进行可靠操控颇具挑战性。我们提出了一种交互式感知框架，该框架能够直接从舀取过程中采集的力-力矩测量数据中推断颗粒材料的物理属性。所提出的Latent Filter++方法将仿生频率-时间滤波器组表示与因果潜变量动力学模型相结合，使得表示能够随着交互观测数据的获取而演进，同时避免了对信号进行手工预处理的需求。学习得到的潜变量表示捕捉了颗粒材料中具有物理意义的变异，并支持对颗粒尺寸和堆积密度等属性的估计。在26种不同的颗粒材料上进行的评估表明，该方法能够泛化至训练中未包含的材料，并利用少量额外的交互样本实现属性特定映射的少样本自适应。最后，我们通过考察推断属性与材料在运输过程中不从勺中洒落所能承受的最大加速度之间的相关性，证明了所推断属性对下游操控任务的相关性。

title: APG-Planner: Learning Vision-Based High-Speed Trajectory Planning via Analytic Policy Gradient
summary: Vision-based high-speed navigation requires a trajectory planner that can reactively generate smooth, collision-free trajectories from onboard visual observations. Deep reinforcement learning offers a promising approach to vision-based trajectory planning, as it enables the optimization of sequential decision-making policies in complex environments. However, model-free policy gradient methods rely on sample-based policy gradient estimation, which yields noisy gradient estimates and inefficient training. To this end, we propose a framework for learning trajectory planning policies using the analytic policy gradient (APG) method and use it to train APG-Planner, a vision-based high-speed trajectory planner. The proposed framework leverages differential flatness to analytically reconstruct vehicle states from planned trajectories, thereby enabling differentiable trajectory-level state transitions without requiring an explicit low-level dynamics model. By iteratively performing trajectory planning and differentiable state transitions, we construct a differentiable episode rollout and analytically compute policy gradients from episode-level losses, improving both training efficiency and policy performance. After approximately 30 minutes of training on a single GPU, APG-Planner demonstrates comparable or superior performance to existing baseline methods in simulation and achieves speeds of up to 11\,m/s in real-world flight experiments. We further validate the proposed framework on a skid-steer ground robot, demonstrating its applicability to differentially flat robotic systems beyond quadrotors.
tldr: This paper introduces APG-Planner, a vision-based high-speed trajectory planning framework using analytic policy gradient (APG) to achieve efficient training and superior performance in simulation and real-world flight, with applications to quadrotors and ground robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出APG-Planner，一种基于视觉的高速轨迹规划框架，利用解析策略梯度（APG）实现高效训练，在仿真和真实飞行中性能优异，并适用于四旋翼和地面机器人。
summary_zh: 基于视觉的高速导航需要一种轨迹规划器，能够根据机载视觉观测反应性地生成平滑且无碰撞的轨迹。深度强化学习为基于视觉的轨迹规划提供了一种有前景的方法，因为它能够在复杂环境中优化序列决策策略。然而，无模型策略梯度方法依赖于基于样本的策略梯度估计，这会导致梯度估计存在噪声且训练效率低下。为此，我们提出了一种利用解析策略梯度（APG）方法学习轨迹规划策略的框架，并使用该框架训练了APG-Planner——一种基于视觉的高速轨迹规划器。所提出的框架利用微分平坦性从规划轨迹中解析地重构车辆状态，从而在不依赖显式底层动力学模型的情况下，实现轨迹级状态转移的可微化。通过迭代执行轨迹规划和可微状态转移，我们构建了可微的分幕展开（episode rollout），并基于分幕级损失解析地计算策略梯度，从而提升了训练效率和策略性能。在单个GPU上训练约30分钟后，APG-Planner在仿真中展现出与现有基线方法相当或更优的性能，并在真实世界飞行实验中达到了最高11 m/s的速度。我们进一步在滑移转向地面机器人上验证了所提出的框架，证明其不仅适用于四旋翼，也适用于其他微分平坦机器人系统。

title: Autonomous Trail Racing with a Bicycle Robot
summary: Navigating off-road trails on a mountain bike requires diverse locomotion skills, including aerial maneuvers, cornering, and slip recovery, paired with sophisticated perception for scene understanding. Translating these capabilities to autonomous, two-wheeled robots remains a formidable challenge. We show that autonomous, high-speed trail navigation can be achieved through a single idea: encoding the trail as a semantic layer of the terrain. In simulation, this layer embeds the navigation task into the training environment; during deployment, it is reconstructed onboard from camera and LiDAR data. First, we introduce a unified learning framework that treats local navigation and locomotion as a joint optimization problem, bypassing the twist or pose command interface of classical control hierarchies. With fixed reward weights, the same framework produces both trail racing and agile parkour, shaped only through terrain semantics and episode length. Second, our perception pipeline combines a frozen vision foundation model with a lightweight dual-head decoder that predicts per-pixel terrain semantics and confidence scores, which are fused with LiDAR range measurements into an egocentric semantic elevation map at 30 Hz onboard an NVIDIA AGX Orin. We validate our framework on the Ultra Mobility Vehicle (UMV), a bicycle robot that autonomously raced across all sections of a kilometer-long, unstructured mountain bike trail at speeds exceeding 5 m/s and averaging 3.26 m/s. In simulation, our policy fails up to an order of magnitude less often than hierarchical baselines while driving faster.
tldr: This paper presents a learning framework for autonomous trail racing on a bicycle robot, using trail semantics embedded as a terrain layer, trained with a joint optimization of navigation and locomotion, and deployed with a semantic elevation map built from camera and LiDAR onboard, demonstrating high-speed off-road racing in the real world.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种用于自行车机器人自主越野赛跑的框架，将赛道语义嵌入地形层，通过联合优化导航与运动进行训练，并在部署时利用机载相机与激光雷达构建语义高程图，实现了实车高速越野。
summary_zh: 导航越野山地自行车赛道需要多种运动技能，包括空中动作、过弯和打滑恢复，同时还需具备精细的场景理解感知能力。将这些能力迁移至自主双轮机器人仍是一项艰巨挑战。我们证明，自主高速赛道导航可通过一个核心理念实现：将赛道编码为地形的语义层。在仿真中，该语义层将导航任务嵌入训练环境；在实际部署中，则通过摄像头和激光雷达数据在车载端实时重建。首先，我们引入一个统一学习框架，将局部导航与运动控制视为联合优化问题，绕过经典控制层级中的扭转或位姿命令接口。在固定奖励权重下，该框架仅通过地形语义和回合长度调节，即可同时生成赛道竞速与敏捷跑酷行为。其次，我们的感知流程结合冻结视觉基础模型与轻量级双头解码器，逐像素预测地形语义及置信度分数，并将其与激光雷达测距数据融合，在NVIDIA AGX Orin车载平台上以30 Hz频率生成自我中心的语义高程图。我们在超机动车辆（UMV）上验证了该框架——这是一款自行车机器人，它以超过5 m/s的速度、平均3.26 m/s的速度自主穿越了一公里多非结构化山地自行车赛道的全部路段。在仿真中，我们的策略在行驶速度更快的同时，失败频率比层级化基线方法低至多一个数量级。

title: DroneDiffusion: Uncertainty-Guided Diffusion Path Planner for UAV Navigation
summary: We present DroneDiffusion, a perception-aware diffusion planner for local 3-D UAV trajectory generation that explicitly models and avoids failure zones caused by lens flare, overexposure, and reflective surfaces. A vision-language perceptual safety estimator produces a pixel-aligned reliability map that highlights regions of degraded sensing. A denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) is conditioned on this map together with the onboard RGB image, goal point, and initial velocity to generate egocentric 3-D trajectories. To enforce obstacle avoidance at inference time without retraining, we apply training-free CHOMP guidance over a 3-D Euclidean signed distance field. The model is trained entirely in simulation and deployed zero-shot on a real drone. Reliability conditioning raises the mean perceptual reliability along generated trajectories to 0.71, compared with 0.63 for a geometric baseline, while guidance halves the collision rate of the learned prior from 14.7% to 7.8%. Perceptual safety conditioning and geometric guidance are therefore complementary: treating sensor reliability as a first-class signal reduces incursions into unreliable regions while maintaining competitive navigation performance.
tldr: DroneDiffusion presents a perception-aware diffusion planner for UAV navigation that uses a vision-language reliability estimator to avoid sensing-degraded regions (e.g., lens flare), with training-free geometric CHOMP guidance for collision avoidance, demonstrated zero-shot on a real drone.
tldr_zh: DroneDiffusion 提出了一种感知感知的扩散路径规划器，用于无人机导航，通过视觉-语言可靠性估计器避免镜头眩光等传感退化区域，并结合无需训练的几何引导实现避障，已在真实无人机上零样本部署。
summary_zh: 我们提出了DroneDiffusion，一种面向局部三维无人机轨迹生成的感知感知扩散规划器，其显式建模并规避由镜头眩光、过度曝光和反射表面引起的感知失效区域。视觉-语言感知安全估计器生成像素对齐的可靠性图，突出显示感知退化区域。去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）以该可靠性图以及机载RGB图像、目标点和初始速度为条件，生成以自我为中心的三维轨迹。为在推理时无需重新训练即可实现避障，我们在三维欧几里得符号距离场上应用无需训练的CHOMP引导。该模型完全在仿真中训练，并零样本部署于真实无人机。可靠性条件约束将生成轨迹沿线的平均感知可靠性提升至0.71，而几何基线仅为0.63；同时，引导将学习先验的碰撞率从14.7%降低一半至7.8%。因此，感知安全条件约束与几何引导具有互补性：将传感器可靠性作为一等信号处理，可在保持竞争性导航性能的同时，减少对不可靠区域的侵入。

title: Are We Ready for Snow-tonomous Driving? Challenges Toward Robust Automated Driving in Extreme Weather
summary:
Automated driving has gained remarkable momentum over the past decade, with both industry and academia investing substantial resources in developing perception and control solutions to advance vehicle autonomy. However, these efforts have largely focused on clear-weather scenarios, leaving harsh conditions, such as snow, rain, and fog, comparatively understudied. As a result, inclement weather remains one of the most significant hurdles for autonomous vehicles, often leading to substantial performance degradation in downstream perception and control tasks.
  In this paper, we present insights from the EU-funded Horizon Europe project ROADVIEW, which aims to develop robust, weather-aware perception and control modules for connected and automated vehicles operating under severe conditions, including snow, rain, and fog. Drawing on four years of large-scale development and real-world demonstrations across multiple vehicle platforms in different locations, we identify ten key challenges that hinder the development of weather-resilient autonomy, including data scarcity, domain shifts, limitations in multimodal perception, control robustness, and validation gaps, among others. We summarize these challenges and lessons learned toward enabling reliable snow-autonomous driving, highlighting critical directions for future research and standardization.
tldr: This paper shares lessons learned from the EU-funded ROADVIEW project, identifying ten key challenges for autonomous driving in extreme weather conditions like snow, rain, and fog, and calling for future research and standardization.
tldr_zh: 本文分享了欧盟资助的ROADVIEW项目的经验，指出了极端天气（如雪、雨、雾）下自动驾驶面临的十大关键挑战，并呼吁未来研究和标准化。
summary_zh:
自动驾驶技术在过去的十年中取得了显著进展，工业界和学术界均投入了大量资源，致力于研发感知与控制解决方案，以推动车辆自主性的提升。然而，这些努力主要聚焦于晴好天气场景，而对雪、雨、雾等恶劣条件下的研究相对不足。因此，恶劣天气仍是自动驾驶汽车面临的最大障碍之一，常常导致下游感知与控制任务的性能显著下降。
本文介绍了欧盟资助的“地平线欧洲”项目ROADVIEW的研究成果，该项目旨在为在雪、雨、雾等严酷条件下运行的网联与自动驾驶汽车开发鲁棒的、具备天气感知能力的感知与控制模块。基于在多个不同地点的车辆平台上历时四年的大规模开发与实际道路演示，我们识别出阻碍天气适应性自动驾驶发展的十大关键挑战，包括数据稀缺、域偏移、多模态感知局限、控制鲁棒性以及验证缺口等。我们总结了这些挑战及经验教训，旨在为实现可靠的雪地自动驾驶提供支持，并指出未来研究与标准化的重要方向。

title: Decide Before You Move: Diffusion-Generated Search Reference for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Object Navigation in Semi-Static Environments
summary: Open-world navigation requires a robot to locate a user-specified target in an indoor scene under open-vocabulary queries. Realistic indoor environments are semi-static: walls and furniture largely persist while smaller objects move, relocate, or vanish between visits. Prior-map systems answer queries from object poses recorded at reconstruction time, which expire as soon as objects move, whereas online methods re-derive where to look from current observations every few steps, often through expensive calls to a vision--language model. Assuming that walls and large furniture do not move, we keep their map to plan paths, but use a target--furniture co-occurrence prior to decide where to search. We present PreNav, an ObjectNav framework on semi-static environments. Rather than invoking a vision-language model at each step, PreNav generates a single global search reference before the robot moves: an LLM converts target--furniture co-occurrence into a spatial prior, a conditional diffusion model turns that prior and the persistent structure into an ordered centerline with a band around it, and the robot approaches the target once it is detected online. Experiments on a Gibson ObjectNav benchmark show that PreNav outperforms a strong online baseline under matched structural priors, using a generator trained only on room-level ScanNet++ scenes and applied to floor-level Gibson without fine-tuning. Real-world experiments under object relocation and open-vocabulary queries further validate the approach.
tldr: PreNav generates a single global search reference using an LLM and a conditional diffusion model for zero-shot open-vocabulary object navigation in semi-static environments, outperforming online baselines and validating in real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: PreNav利用LLM和条件扩散模型生成全局搜索参考，用于半静态环境中的零样本开放词汇目标导航，在基准和真实世界实验中优于在线基线。
summary_zh: 开放世界导航要求机器人在开放词汇查询下，于室内场景中定位用户指定的目标。真实室内环境具有半静态特性：墙壁和大型家具基本保持不变，而较小的物体则在两次访问之间发生移动、移位或消失。基于先验地图的系统依赖重建时记录的目标姿态来回答查询，一旦物体移动，这些姿态便随之失效；而在线方法则每隔几步便依据当前观测重新推导搜索位置，通常需要调用昂贵的视觉-语言模型。鉴于墙壁和大型家具不会移动，我们保留其地图用于路径规划，但利用目标-家具共现先验来决定搜索位置。我们提出PreNav，一种面向半静态环境的ObjectNav框架。PreNav并非在每一步都调用视觉-语言模型，而是在机器人移动前生成单一的全局搜索参考：大语言模型将目标-家具共现转换为空间先验，条件扩散模型将该先验与持久结构转化为带周边带状区域的有序中心线，机器人在线检测到目标后即向其靠近。在Gibson ObjectNav基准上的实验表明，在匹配的结构先验条件下，PreNav优于强在线基线方法，所使用的生成器仅在房间级ScanNet++场景上训练，并直接应用于楼层级Gibson而无需微调。在物体移位和开放词汇查询条件下的真实世界实验进一步验证了该方法的有效性。

title: CrowdMAPS: Crowdsourcing Multiple Actions per State for Real-World Imitation Learning
summary: Real-world robot imitation learning is often limited by the cost of collecting physical demonstrations, which typically yield only one action label per visited state. We present CrowdMAPS, a web-based crowdsourcing paradigm for augmenting real-robot datasets with Multiple Actions per State (MAPS). After or during standard robot data collection, CrowdMAPS distributes visited robot states to remote annotators through a web-based 3D interface, where they specify alternative valid actions without requiring access to physical robot hardware. This expands robot datasets along a complementary "width" dimension--by increasing the number of actions per visited state--rather than only by collecting more trajectories. We evaluate CrowdMAPS using keyframe-centric goal-pose annotations supplied by non-expert annotators and train imitation policies on the resulting MAPS data. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, increasing MAPS width from one to ten actions per state improves sample efficiency and increases average success rates by 35.6 percentage points for keypose policies and 33.0 percentage points for trajectory policies. These results show that software-mediated human annotations can augment physical robot data to afford denser supervision, establishing CrowdMAPS as a scalable digital layer for real-robot data collection.
tldr: CrowdMAPS introduces a web-based crowdsourcing paradigm to collect multiple action labels per robot state, augmenting real-robot imitation learning datasets and improving policy success rates across five manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: CrowdMAPS 提出了一种基于网络的众包范式，为每个机器人状态收集多个动作标签，增强真实机器人模仿学习数据集，并在五个操作任务中提高了策略成功率。
summary_zh: 现实世界中的机器人模仿学习常常受限于物理演示数据的采集成本，通常每个访问到的状态仅能对应一个动作标签。我们提出了CrowdMAPS，一种基于网络的众包范式，用于为真实机器人数据集扩展“每状态多动作”（Multiple Actions per State, MAPS）的标注。在标准机器人数据采集过程中或采集之后，CrowdMAPS通过基于网络的3D界面将机器人访问到的状态分发给远程标注者，标注者无需接触实际机器人硬件即可指定替代的有效动作。这种方式沿着互补的“宽度”维度扩展机器人数据集——即增加每个访问状态对应的动作数量，而不仅仅是采集更多轨迹。我们利用非专家标注者提供的以关键帧为中心的目标位姿标注来评估CrowdMAPS，并在生成的MAPS数据上训练模仿学习策略。在五个真实世界操作任务中，将MAPS宽度从每个状态一个动作增加到十个动作，显著提升了样本效率，并使关键位姿策略的平均成功率提高了35.6个百分点，轨迹策略的平均成功率提高了33.0个百分点。这些结果表明，软件介导的人工标注能够增强物理机器人数据，提供更密集的监督信号，从而使CrowdMAPS成为真实机器人数据采集中可扩展的数字层。

title: Does Your World Model Know Actions Have Consequences?
summary: Embodied world models (WMs) are implicit learning systems that predict the next future latent state directly from observations and actions. Unique from other end-to-end learning systems, the dynamics predictor of WMs can simulate the environment's response to alternative actions without physical deployment nor pre-specifying states of the dynamical system. Current metrics focus on the quality of model outputs, e.g., clarity of reconstructions or task success, but fail to assess the fidelity of modeling consequences of counterfactual actions. Inspecting the forced response to action perturbations through sensitivity analysis is one way to audit how well WMs can predict the consequences of counterfactual actions. Deploying WMs on hardware will require new evaluation frameworks to analyze the tradeoffs between state error and accurate sensitivity prediction.
tldr: This paper proposes a sensitivity-analysis-based evaluation framework for embodied world models to assess their fidelity in modeling counterfactual action consequences, addressing metrics beyond reconstruction quality or task success.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于敏感性分析的评估框架，用于检测具身世界模型对反事实动作后果的建模保真度，弥补了现有指标仅关注重建质量或任务成功率的不足。
summary_zh: 具身世界模型（WMs）是一种隐式学习系统，能够直接从观测和动作中预测未来的潜在状态。与其他端到端学习系统不同，世界模型的动力学预测器可以在无需物理部署或预先指定动力系统状态的情况下，模拟环境对替代动作的响应。当前的评估指标侧重于模型输出的质量，例如重建的清晰度或任务成功率，但未能评估对反事实动作后果建模的保真度。通过敏感性分析检查对动作扰动的强迫响应，是审计世界模型预测反事实动作后果能力的一种途径。将世界模型部署到硬件上，将需要新的评估框架来分析状态误差与准确敏感性预测之间的权衡。

title: Genie Sim Benchmark: Real-to-Sim Fidelity and Evaluation
summary: We evaluate Genie Sim Benchmark through paired real-simulation tasks and complementary system-identification studies. Across 22 robot-task pairs spanning 16 task names, task-specific pi0.5 policies fine-tuned on real-robot data achieve a descriptive Score correlation of 0.9686, MAE 0.0405, RMSE 0.0520, with simulation-real differences from -0.110 to +0.080. G2 crsB experiments assess long-horizon closed-loop position and joint-side torque agreement, while five representative object cases examine identification and cross-engine contact transfer. A separate 32.6503 s teleoperation trajectory, excluded from mechanical identification and servo-gain search, evaluates external position targets through simulated motion-controller command shaping and a calibrated position servo. Across both arms, per-joint position RMSE spans 0.00614-0.03522 rad and current-derived torque RMSE spans 0.73545-4.00099 N m. Native PhysX adaptations recover three recorded interaction tasks, with case-dependent alignment gains. These results support task-specific simulation evaluation through joint assessment of task outcomes and physical-response consistency.
tldr: This paper evaluates the Genie Sim Benchmark, a real-to-sim simulation environment, by comparing task outcomes and physical response consistency across 22 robot-task pairs using pi0.5 policies, and validating system identification and contact transfer through teleoperation trajectories and object interaction tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文通过22个机器人-任务对，使用pi0.5策略评估Genie Sim Benchmark的真实到仿真保真度，并验证系统辨识和接触传递的准确性。
summary_zh: 我们通过配对的真实-仿真任务及互补的系统辨识研究，对Genie Sim Benchmark进行了评估。在涵盖16个任务名称的22个机器人-任务配对中，基于真实机器人数据微调的任务特定pi0.5策略实现了描述性评分相关系数0.9686，平均绝对误差0.0405，均方根误差0.0520，仿真与真实之间的差异范围为-0.110至+0.080。G2 crsB实验评估了长时域闭环位置及关节侧力矩的一致性，同时五个代表性物体案例考察了辨识及跨引擎接触传递性能。另一段独立采集的32.6503秒遥操作轨迹（未参与机械辨识及伺服增益搜索）通过仿真运动控制器指令整形及标定位置伺服，用于评估外部位置目标。双臂各关节位置均方根误差范围为0.00614-0.03522弧度，电流换算力矩均方根误差范围为0.73545-4.00099牛·米。原生PhysX适配恢复了三个记录在案的交互任务，并取得了依案例而定的对齐增益。上述结果通过任务结果与物理响应一致性的联合评估，支持任务特定的仿真验证。

title: Fast Inference-Time Policy Refinement via Action-Affine World Models
summary: Imitation policies can perform complex manipulation, yet small execution errors can accumulate and cause failure. Refinement can correct these errors, but existing approaches often require additional on-policy learning or costly online planning. Our key insight is that a pretrained policy already supplies a useful nominal behavior: refinement can focus on predicting how small action corrections change its outcome. We therefore learn this local response in a form that is cheap to optimize. Our \textit{action-affine world model} (A\textsuperscript{2}WM) learns local action sensitivities offline from action-perturbed policy rollouts. Given interaction history and a policy proposal, it predicts task-relevant geometry as a nominal trajectory plus a linear response to corrections. It predicts the full planning horizon directly, avoiding the propagation of intermediate errors through recursive model evaluations. Quadratic penalties on predicted task errors and linear correction constraints then yield a cheap convex quadratic program (QP). Online refinement requires one model evaluation and one QP solve, while both policy and model weights remain frozen. Across four simulated manipulation tasks, our framework achieves the highest success rate among evaluated baselines, adding only 3.8 ms of mean refinement overhead per control step, excluding base-policy sampling.
tldr: This paper presents an action-affine world model (A2WM) that enables fast, offline refinement of imitation policies by predicting a nominal trajectory and a linear response to action corrections, solved via a convex QP at inference time with frozen weights.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种动作仿射世界模型（A2WM），通过预测名义轨迹和对动作修正的线性响应，在推理时通过凸二次规划快速优化，实现对模仿策略的离线快速修正。
summary_zh: 模仿策略能够执行复杂的操作任务，但微小的执行误差可能会累积并导致失败。细化过程可以纠正这些误差，然而现有方法往往需要额外的在线策略学习或成本高昂的在线规划。我们的关键见解是，预训练的策略已经提供了有用的标称行为：细化可以聚焦于预测小的动作修正如何改变其输出结果。因此，我们以一种易于优化的形式学习这种局部响应。我们的\textit{动作仿射世界模型}（A\textsuperscript{2}WM）离线地从动作扰动的策略轨迹中学习局部动作敏感性。给定交互历史和策略提议，它预测任务相关几何结构，形式为标称轨迹加上对修正的线性响应。该模型直接预测整个规划时域，避免了通过递归模型评估传播中间误差。对预测任务误差的二次惩罚和线性修正约束共同构成了一个成本低廉的凸二次规划（QP）问题。在线细化仅需一次模型评估和一次QP求解，且策略和模型权重均保持冻结。在四个模拟操作任务中，我们的框架在所评估的基线方法中取得了最高的成功率，每个控制步仅增加3.8毫秒的平均细化开销（不包括基础策略采样）。

title: Can I join you? Extended Social Force Based Model with Predictive Control and Barrier Functions for Humanoid Group Repositioning Amidst Obstacles
summary: As social and service robots increasingly share interaction spaces in public, they may form groups while coordinating tasks or interacting with humans. Initial group formation alone is insufficient in dynamic settings, because it can be disrupted when a person or another agent joins, leaves, or passes through the group. Although group dynamics and repositioning have been widely studied in swarm robotics and virtual-agent settings, little attention has been given to socially appropriate repositioning behaviors in groups of humanoid robots. Existing social-force-based approaches provide a useful foundation for group behavior, but they have limited obstacle handling, and can produce unsafe behavior as environmental complexity increases. We propose a novel framework that modulates traditional Social Force, guided by Model Predictive Control (MPC) to plan ahead, bounded by Control Barrier Functions (CBF) to increase safety for robot groups repositioning behaviors. This approach aims to produce safer and socially aware group repositioning behaviors under various group formation disturbance. We evaluate the method in simulation through an ablation study and an online user study. The results show that our proposed method can produce smoother and safer repositioning behaviors in complex environments while preserving social appropriateness.
tldr: This paper introduces a framework for humanoid robot groups to safely and socially reposition in dynamic environments by combining Social Force with Model Predictive Control and Control Barrier Functions, validated in simulation with an ablation study and user evaluation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种融合社会力、模型预测控制和控制障碍函数的框架，用于人形机器人群体在动态环境中安全且符合社交礼仪的重新定位行为，并在仿真中通过消融研究和用户研究进行了验证。
summary_zh: 随着社交与服务型机器人在公共空间中日益增多地共享交互场景，它们在协调任务或与人类互动时可能形成群体。然而，在动态环境中，仅仅初步形成群体并不足够，因为当有人或其他智能体加入、离开或穿行其间时，群体结构可能被打乱。尽管群集动态和重新定位问题在群体机器人和虚拟智能体领域已得到广泛研究，但在仿人机器人群体中，关于社会适宜的重定位行为的研究却相对较少。现有的基于社会力的方法为群体行为提供了有益的基础，但其在障碍物处理方面存在局限，且随着环境复杂性增加，可能产生不安全的行为。我们提出了一种新颖的框架，对传统社会力模型进行调节，采用模型预测控制（MPC）进行前瞻性规划，并以控制障碍函数（CBF）为约束，以提升机器人群体重定位行为的安全性。该方法旨在面对多种群体结构扰动时，产生更安全且具有社会意识的群体重定位行为。我们通过消融研究和在线用户研究在仿真环境中对该方法进行了评估。结果表明，我们提出的方法能够在复杂环境中产生更平滑、更安全的重定位行为，同时保持社会的适宜性。

title: SPIRE: Task-agnostic embodied continual learning through autonomous situation inference and causal motor-primitive reuse
summary: Embodied continual learning requires controllers to infer changing situations, retain prior behavior and reuse motor skills without task labels or known boundaries. The challenge is deciding when to recover earlier behavior and which skills can support new learning. We introduce Situation-guided Primitive Integration for Recurrent Embodiment (SPIRE), a recurrent-spiking system that infers latent contexts from action-outcome evidence and learns context-specific motor actors online. Mature actors become protected sources that combine with a target-context residual to drive recurrent-spiking motor populations. Across coordinate, three-joint and hidden-force control, SPIRE maintained control, autonomously inferred situations, retained prior behavior and accelerated acquisition of an unseen source composition, reducing mean interactions to criterion by approximately 40% relative to matched fresh controllers. Rewinding compatible source actors impaired early acquisition in every matched intervention, demonstrating causal reuse. Against seven recurrent continual-learning and modular-control comparators, SPIRE achieved 2.4 times the mean prior-learning advantage of the strongest eligible task-free alternative selected for each paired stream. These results demonstrate autonomous recovery and causal reuse of motor skills for new learning in continuous embodied control.
tldr: SPIRE proposes a recurrent-spiking embodied continual learning system that infers latent contexts and reuses causal motor primitives, improving sample efficiency by ~40% and surpassing seven comparators.
tldr_zh: SPIRE 提出了一种基于脉冲神经网络的具身持续学习方法，通过自主推断情境并重用因果运动基元，在多个控制任务上减少约40%的交互次数，并在七个对照方法中取得最佳性能。
summary_zh: 具身持续学习要求控制器在没有任务标签或已知边界的情况下，推断不断变化的情境、保留先前行为并复用运动技能。其挑战在于决定何时恢复先前行为，以及哪些技能能够支持新学习。我们提出了用于循环具身的情境引导原语整合方法（SPIRE），这是一种循环脉冲系统，能够从动作-结果证据中推断潜在情境，并在线学习情境特定的运动执行器。成熟执行器成为受保护的来源，与目标情境残差相结合，驱动循环脉冲运动群体。在坐标控制、三关节控制和隐力控制任务中，SPIRE均保持了控制性能，自主推断情境，保留先前行为，并加速了对未见来源组合的习得，相较于匹配的新控制器，达到标准的平均交互次数减少了约40%。在所有匹配干预中，回放兼容来源执行器均损害了早期习得，证明了因果复用效应。与七种循环持续学习和模块化控制比较方法相比，SPIRE在每对配对流上取得了最强合格无任务替代方法平均先前学习优势的2.4倍。这些结果证明了在连续具身控制中，运动技能能够被自主恢复并因果复用以支持新学习。

title: Can MLLMs Reason over Surround-View Driving Videos? A Multi-View Autonomous Driving QA Benchmark
summary: Surround-view video understanding in autonomous driving is a crucial capability for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to achieve reliable driving reasoning. Real-world driving often requires information beyond the front-view camera. Existing MLLMs primarily focus on front-view information, while their spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning abilities remain unknown. To address this gap, we propose MVDriveBench, a high-information-density video QA benchmark for autonomous driving, characterized by synchronized surround-view inputs, spatio-temporal understanding, and reasoning-chain-oriented evaluation. We design 12 categories of QA tasks that cover the complete reasoning pipeline from low-level visual perception to high-level driving decision-making, enabling a systematic evaluation of MLLMs surround-view spatio-temporal understanding and reasoning capabilities in complex driving environments. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 23 open-source, closed-source, and expert MLLMs on MVDriveBench. The results show that current MLLMs still exhibit insufficient surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning ability. Meanwhile, closed-loop evaluations of specialist models in AlpaSim reveal a correlation between surround-view spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities and closed-loop driving performance, highlighting the importance of comprehensive multi-view understanding for reliable vehicle control.
tldr: MVDriveBench is a new benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on surround-view driving video understanding, featuring 12 QA task categories and showing current MLLMs still lack sufficient spatio-temporal reasoning, with a correlation to closed-loop driving performance.
tldr_zh: MVDriveBench 是一个用于评估多模态大语言模型在环视驾驶视频理解能力的新基准，包含12类问答任务，结果显示现有MLLMs在时空推理上仍有不足，且该能力与闭环驾驶性能相关。
summary_zh: 环绕视图视频理解是自动驾驶中多模态大语言模型实现可靠驾驶推理的关键能力。实际驾驶场景往往需要超越前视摄像头的多维度信息。现有的大语言模型主要聚焦于前视信息，其时空理解与推理能力尚不明确。为填补这一空白，我们提出了MVDriveBench——一个面向自动驾驶的高信息密度视频问答基准，其特点是同步环绕视图输入、时空理解以及面向推理链的评估。我们设计了12类问答任务，覆盖从低层视觉感知到高层驾驶决策的完整推理链路，能够系统评估多模态大语言模型在复杂驾驶环境中的环绕视图时空理解与推理能力。我们基于MVDriveBench对23个开源、闭源及专家模型进行了全面评估。结果表明，当前多模态大语言模型在环绕视图时空推理方面仍存在明显不足。同时，在AlpaSim中对专家模型的闭环评估显示，环绕视图时空推理能力与闭环驾驶性能之间存在相关性，凸显了全面的多视角理解对实现可靠车辆控制的重要性。

title: IncR-3DSGG: Incremental Posed RGB Image Based 3D Scene Graph Generation via Privileged Depth Supervision
summary: Scene graphs provide a compact, structured representation of environments by capturing objects and their spatial or semantic relationships in a form suitable for embodied agents. Existing 3D scene graph generation methods often rely on depth sensing at inference, either to associate object instances across views via point cloud overlap or to compute inter-object relations from geometric cues, limiting deployment to platforms with depth sensors. We propose IncR-3DSGG, which builds 3D scene graphs incrementally from posed\footnote{RGB images with camera extrinsics estimated by an off-the-shelf visual SLAM system.} RGB images, eliminating the use of depth sensors at inference. Our method leverages a Parametric Relation Predictor (PRP) that learns to estimate pairwise distances and relative angles between objects from 2D visual features and 2D geometric cues, using 3D geometric supervision available only during training. These learned pairwise measurements are fused across views through Pose Graph Optimization (PGO)~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial} to recover metrically grounded 3D object positions and build a globally consistent 3D scene graph incrementally. On the real-world 3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio} dataset, our method attains $52.2$ mean object recall and $30.8$ mean predicate recall under the 3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning} evaluation protocol, against $27.0$ and $17.6$ for MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}, while using no depth or reconstructed geometry at inference. This shows that relations and metrically grounded 3D object representations can be predicted from posed RGB images alone.
tldr: IncR-3DSGG incrementally builds 3D scene graphs from posed RGB images only, using a Parametric Relation Predictor trained with 3D geometric supervision to estimate pairwise distances and angles, and fusing them via Pose Graph Optimization to achieve metric 3D object positions without depth sensors at inference.
tldr_zh: IncR-3DSGG仅利用带位姿的RGB图像增量构建3D场景图，通过参数化关系预测器在3D几何监督下学习估计物体间的距离和角度，并利用位姿图优化融合多视角信息，在推理时无需深度传感器即可恢复度量的3D物体位置。
summary_zh: 场景图通过捕捉对象及其空间或语义关系，以适用于具身智能体的形式，提供了一种紧凑且结构化的环境表示。现有的三维场景图生成方法通常在推理时依赖深度感知，要么通过点云重叠跨视图关联对象实例，要么基于几何线索计算对象间关系，这限制了其在配备深度传感器的平台上的部署。我们提出IncR-3DSGG，该方法从带有位姿的RGB图像（注：指通过现成的视觉SLAM系统估计相机外参的RGB图像）中增量式构建三维场景图，从而在推理时消除对深度传感器的依赖。我们的方法利用参数化关系预测器（PRP），该预测器从二维视觉特征和二维几何线索中学习估计对象之间的成对距离和相对角度，仅在训练期间使用三维几何监督。这些学习到的成对测量值通过位姿图优化（PGO）~\cite{grisetti2010tutorial}跨视图融合，以恢复具有度量基准的三维对象位置，并增量式构建全局一致的三维场景图。在真实世界3RScan~\cite{wald2019rio}数据集上，我们的方法在3DSSG~\cite{wald2020learning}评估协议下分别达到了$52.2$的平均对象召回率和$30.8$的平均谓词召回率，而MonoSSG~\cite{wu2023incremental}仅为$27.0$和$17.6$，且我们的方法在推理时不使用任何深度信息或重建几何。这表明，仅凭带位姿的RGB图像即可预测关系和度量基准的三维对象表示。

title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
summary: In this report, we introduce the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and present Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. The RWM treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental to what constitutes a world. Existing world models largely focus on simulating the latter, leaving reasoning and decision-making as external controls rather than intrinsic parts of the world itself. In RWM, we identify two equally fundamental capabilities: Intent, which provides the cognition underlying world interactions, and Realization, which generates coherent audio-visual behavior. To realize this formulation, Duo v1 introduces three key technical designs: (1) Leveraging autoregressive modeling for continuous interaction reasoning and participation decisions, rather than restricting it to instruction understanding for diffusion models. (2) Constructing chunk-specific conditions and synchronize tokens across Intent and Realization on a unified timeline. Module-specific attention masks enforce causal dependencies both within and across chunks, preventing access to future inputs. (3) Mitigating distribution shift in both modules through dual rollout distillation, training on autoregressively generated Intent tokens and synthesized audiovisual histories from Realization. Both modules continuously perceive real-time audio, video, and text, enabling full-duplex interaction with spontaneous conversations and interruptions. Beyond conversation, users can share real objects, reshape virtual scenes, guide assistants, or play audiovisual games without mouse or keyboard controls. The release of Duo v1 makes our first step, with the next version coming soon. We look forward to broader exploration of this emerging field.
tldr: This paper introduces the Reciprocal World Model (RWM) and presents Duo v1, a full-duplex world model that continuously perceives audiovisual inputs while responding to users in real time. It treats intelligence and physical reality as equally fundamental parts of a world, enabling spontaneous conversations and interactions in virtual and physical scenes.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了互惠世界模型（RWM）并发布了Duo v1，一种全双工世界模型，可实时感知视听输入并响应用户。它将智能与物理现实视为构成世界的基本要素，支持自发对话和虚拟/物理场景中的交互。
summary_zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了交互世界模型（RWM），并展示了Duo v1——一个全双工世界模型，它能够持续感知视听输入，同时实时响应用户。RWM将智能与物理现实视为构成世界的同等基本要素。现有世界模型大多侧重于模拟后者，将推理与决策作为外部控制，而非世界本身的内在组成部分。在RWM中，我们确定了两个同等基本的能力：意图（Intent），提供世界交互背后的认知基础；实现（Realization），生成连贯的视听行为。为实现这一构思，Duo v1引入了三项关键技术设计：（1）利用自回归建模进行连续交互推理与参与决策，而非仅限于扩散模型的指令理解。（2）构建分块特定条件，并在统一时间线上同步意图与实现之间的令牌。模块特定的注意力掩码在块内及块间强制执行因果依赖，防止访问未来输入。（3）通过双重展开蒸馏缓解两个模块中的分布偏移，训练基于自回归生成的意图令牌及由实现模块合成的视听历史。两个模块持续感知实时音频、视频和文本，实现全双工交互，支持自发对话与打断。除对话外，用户无需鼠标或键盘控制即可共享实物、重塑虚拟场景、引导助手或参与视听游戏。Duo v1的发布是我们迈出的第一步，下一版本即将推出。我们期待这一新兴领域更广泛的探索。

title: Helping Hand: A Continuum Robotic Grasper for Traction in Single-Channel Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection
summary: Endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) is a minimally invasive approach for removing large polyps from the colon and offers many benefits compared to other surgical approaches. However, ESD is technically very challenging to perform, leading to limited adoption by physicians. We propose the Helping Hand, a two-segment continuum robotic grasper that, together with an electrosurgical knife, enables tissue traction and cutting within a single 3.7 mm working channel. We achieve this functionality by creating a slot at the base of the Helping Hand that lets the electrosurgical knife extend out, enabling countertraction and cutting through one instrument lumen. We evaluate the Helping Hand's workspace and its ability to provide traction forces from different starting configurations. Finally, we demonstrate the full workflow by isolating and removing tissue in an ex vivo chicken thigh, illustrating the potential for the Helping Hand to help improve ESD procedures.
tldr: The paper presents a novel two-segment continuum robotic grasper designed to provide traction within a single-channel endoscopic submucosal dissection (ESD) procedure, enabling simultaneous tissue traction and cutting with an electrosurgical knife.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种双段连续体机器人抓持器，用于在单通道内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）中提供牵引，从而实现组织牵引和切割的同步进行。
summary_zh: 内镜黏膜下剥离术（ESD）是一种微创方法，用于切除结肠中的大型息肉，与其他手术方法相比具有诸多优势。然而，ESD在技术上极具挑战性，导致其被医生采用的普及度受限。我们提出了“助力手”——一种双段连续体机器人抓取器，与电外科刀配合使用，可在单个3.7毫米工作通道内实现组织牵引与切割。为实现这一功能，我们在“助力手”的基座处设计了一个槽口，使电外科刀能够伸出，从而通过单一器械腔道实现反向牵引与切割。我们评估了“助力手”的工作空间及其在不同初始构型下提供牵引力的能力。最后，我们通过离体鸡腿组织中分离并切除组织的完整工作流程演示，展示了“助力手”在改善ESD手术方面的潜力。

title: Prediction or Persistence? What Future-Prediction Scores Miss About World Models
summary: Pretrained video world models are compared and chosen as components for robot learning largely by future-prediction scores. On its own, such a score cannot be read as evidence of prediction, because it mixes encoder quality, the near future's resemblance to the recent past, and the predictor's own contribution. We separate the three with a matched control. On 27,000 future-retrieval trials from household egocentric video, a model must pick the true continuation of a clip among eleven candidates from the same video (chance 0.091), ranked zero-shot by its own training criterion. Each model is paired with a persistence control, an identical copy whose predictor is never invoked, so the paired difference isolates the predictor. Score and contribution dissociate within the native-video V-JEPA family alone: the predictor adds +0.291 top-1 for V-JEPA 2.1 but +0.03 to +0.04 for V-JEPA 2 on the identical trials. Across five models the contribution ranges from +0.291 to negative, and it is negative only for the two action-conditioned models, which we evaluate outside their training regime. Persistence alone recovers the encoder ordering expected from pretraining, a sign that the probe tracks real signal. We suggest reporting each future-prediction score together with its persistence baseline. The gap between them, not the score, is what makes the number interpretable: a necessary check costing one forward pass. Establishing downstream usefulness is a separate matter, for a planning or control evaluation.
tldr: This paper argues that future-prediction scores for video world models conflate encoder quality, recent-past similarity, and predictor contribution, and proposes a persistence baseline to isolate the predictor's contribution, showing that scores alone can mislead when selecting models for robot learning.
tldr_zh: 本文指出视频世界模型的未来预测分数混合了编码器质量、近期相似性和预测器贡献，提出用持续基线分离预测器贡献，证明仅凭分数选择机器人学习模型可能产生误导。
summary_zh: 预训练视频世界模型在机器人学习中被选作组件时，主要依据未来预测得分进行比较。仅凭这一得分本身，并不能将其视为预测能力的证据，因为它混淆了编码器质量、近期未来与近期过去的相似性，以及预测器自身的贡献。我们通过匹配对照将这三者分离开来。在来自家庭场景第一人称视频的27,000次未来检索试验中，模型必须从同一视频的十一个候选项（随机概率为0.091）中选出片段的真实延续，并依据其自身训练准则进行零样本排序。每个模型都与一个持续性对照配对，该对照是相同副本但预测器从未被调用，因此配对差异可单独分离出预测器的贡献。在原生视频V-JEPA系列内部，得分与贡献即出现分离：在完全相同的试验中，V-JEPA 2.1的预测器使Top-1准确率提升+0.291，而V-JEPA 2仅提升+0.03至+0.04。在五种模型中，贡献范围从+0.291到负值不等，且仅有两个动作条件模型的贡献为负——我们是在其训练范围之外对其进行评估的。仅凭持续性对照即可恢复预训练所预期的编码器排序，这表明该探针确实捕捉到了真实信号。我们建议在报告每个未来预测得分时，同时附上其持续性基线。两者之间的差距——而非得分本身——才是使该数值具有可解释性的关键：这是一项仅需一次前向传播成本的必要检验。确立下游实用性则是另一回事，需通过规划或控制评估来进行。

title: MiniPose: Miniature-Based Real Data Collection for 6D Pose Estimation of Large Industrial Pipe Segments
summary: 6-DOF pose estimation of large and heavy industrial objects, such as large piping systems in shipyards and structural components in petrochemical plants, remains relatively underexplored in robotic perception. Repeatedly repositioning large objects is physically and spatially demanding, making it difficult to acquire real training data with sufficient pose diversity. Synthetic data offer a scalable alternative, but faithfully reproducing real RGB-D observations, particularly the structured measurement errors of real depth sensors, remains difficult. We propose MiniPose, a practical pipeline for miniature-based real RGB-D data collection that addresses both the data-acquisition burden and the sim-to-real gap. We fabricate a scaled-down replica and capture RGB-D data of it in diverse poses using a real RGB-D camera. RGB images are used directly, while depth maps are converted to a geometrically consistent representation of the full-scale object via a simple inverse scaling transformation. This allows training to incorporate real appearance and sensor measurement characteristics that are difficult to reproduce using synthetic data alone. To examine whether the benefit depends on a particular network, we evaluate two RGB-D pose estimators with different formulations, PVN3D and RDPN6D. Mixing at most 1,000 miniature images per pipe type, less than 10\% of the training data, with 10,000 synthetic images improves the mean ADD-S AUC across pipe types over synthetic-only training for both estimators. A comparison with training on full-scale real data further suggests that miniature data can serve as a proxy where full-scale collection is difficult, reducing the data-collection burden for large industrial objects.
tldr: MiniPose introduces a miniature-based real RGB-D data collection pipeline for 6D pose estimation of large industrial pipe segments, mitigating data acquisition and sim-to-real gaps by using scaled-down physical replicas with inverse depth scaling. Mixing miniature data with synthetic data improves pose estimation accuracy for two RGB-D estimators, demonstrating its effectiveness as a proxy for full-scale data.
tldr_zh: MiniPose 提出了一种基于微缩模型的真实 RGB-D 数据采集流程，用于大型工业管段的 6D 位姿估计，通过使用缩小比例的物理复制品和逆深度缩放，缓解了数据采集和 sim-to-real 差距。将微缩数据与合成数据混合可提高两种 RGB-D 估计器的位姿估计精度，证明其可作为全尺寸数据的替代方案。
summary_zh: 大型重型工业物体（如船厂中的大型管道系统和化工厂中的结构部件）的6自由度姿态估计在机器人感知领域仍相对未被充分探索。重复 repositioning 大型物体在物理和空间上要求较高，使得获取具有足够姿态多样性的真实训练数据变得困难。合成数据提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，但忠实地再现真实RGB-D观测数据，尤其是真实深度传感器的结构化测量误差，仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了MiniPose，一种基于缩比模型的真实RGB-D数据采集实用流程，同时解决了数据采集负担和仿真到现实差距的问题。我们制作了一个按比例缩小的复制品，并使用真实RGB-D相机以多种姿态采集其RGB-D数据。RGB图像直接使用，而深度图则通过简单的逆缩放变换转换为全尺寸物体的几何一致表示。这使得训练能够融入真实外观和传感器测量特性，而这些特性仅靠合成数据难以复现。为检验该方法的收益是否依赖于特定网络，我们评估了两种不同公式的RGB-D姿态估计器：PVN3D和RDPN6D。对每种管道类型，最多混合1，000张缩比模型图像（占训练数据的不到10%）与10，000张合成图像，在两种估计器上，各管道类型的平均ADD-S AUC均优于仅使用合成数据的训练结果。与在全尺寸真实数据上训练的比较进一步表明，在全尺寸数据采集困难的情况下，缩比模型数据可作为一种替代方案，从而减轻大型工业物体的数据采集负担。

title: Adapting Monocular Depth Estimation in Novel Scenes through Disparity Refinement and Robot Ego-Motion
summary: The geometric understanding of a scene is a crucial component for safe and efficient robotic operations in novel and unstructured environments. The recent emergence of foundation models for Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) has provided an opportunity to enrich robotic perception capabilities with dense long-range depth predictions, replacing expensive onboard hardware (e.g., LiDARs and stereo cameras). However, these offline models are primarily trained on affine-invariant depth representations, and their generalization to novel scenes remains unclear. In this work we present EM-ViT, a monocular depth estimation model that learns to adapt online relative depth inputs from a foundation model prior to the metric scale with observations collected during robotic operations. Motivated by the stereo camera parameterization, our method decomposes depth prediction via dense disparity refinement to recover the scene's relative structure and an effective baseline scalar prediction to determine the missing metric scale. The learning process leverages sparse LiDAR points and, optionally, the robot's Ego-Motion (EM) to rapidly train a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT), while an internal gradient matching loss preserves the fine-grained semantic structure of the input disparity in real-time. We demonstrate the efficacy of our method on publicly available sequences, such as KITTI, and show that our online learning pipeline can adapt to novel scenes faster and with higher accuracy than existing MDE foundation models. The code and supplementary materials will be publicly available at https://emvit-mde.github.io.
tldr: EM-ViT adapts monocular depth estimation foundation models online to novel scenes by decomposing prediction into dense disparity refinement and baseline scalar prediction, using sparse LiDAR and optional ego-motion to train a lightweight ViT, achieving faster and more accurate adaptation on KITTI.
tldr_zh: EM-ViT通过将深度预测分解为密集视差细化和基线标量预测，利用稀疏LiDAR和可选的自运动在线训练轻量级ViT，从而在KITTI等新场景中实现更快、更准确的自适应单目深度估计。
summary_zh: 场景的几何理解是机器人在新颖和非结构化环境中安全高效运行的关键组成部分。近年来，单目深度估计（MDE）基础模型的出现，为丰富机器人感知能力提供了机遇，能够通过密集的长距离深度预测替代昂贵的机载硬件（如激光雷达和双目相机）。然而，这些离线模型主要基于仿射不变深度表示进行训练，其在新场景中的泛化能力尚不明确。在本工作中，我们提出了EM-ViT，一种单目深度估计模型，该模型能够在机器人运行过程中，利用观测数据，将基础模型输出的在线相对深度输入自适应地调整到公制尺度。受双目相机参数化的启发，我们的方法通过密集视差细化来分解深度预测，以恢复场景的相对结构，并通过有效基线标量预测来确定缺失的公制尺度。学习过程利用稀疏激光雷达点，并可选地利用机器人的自运动（EM），以快速训练轻量级视觉Transformer（ViT），同时内部梯度匹配损失能够实时保持输入视差的细粒度语义结构。我们在公开可用的序列（如KITTI）上验证了该方法的有效性，并表明我们的在线学习流程能够比现有MDE基础模型更快、更准确地适应新场景。代码和补充材料将在https://emvit-mde.github.io公开提供。

title: DIVAL: Diffeomorphic Vector-Field Alignment for Nonholonomic Motion Planning
summary: Conventional vector-field-based motion planners for nonholonomic robots consist of two steps: first designing a nominal vector field and then controlling the robot to follow it to approach the target. However, a nonholonomic robot cannot follow the vector field instantaneously and may collide with obstacles, due to the inevitable mismatch between the robot's initial heading and the vector field's direction. This paper proposes a diffeomorphic vector-field alignment (DIVAL) method, which aligns the vector field's direction with the robot's initial heading so the robot can follow the vector field from the start. Specifically, the nominal vector field is locally reshaped by applying a diffeomorphic deformation to the workspace, such that the reshaped vector field has the same direction as the robot's heading at the initial position and coincides with the nominal vector field outside the deformed region. Since DIVAL eliminates the initial heading mismatch, the nonholonomic robot can maintain heading alignment with the reshaped vector field throughout the motion. This heading alignment further ensures that the robot preserves the nominal vector field's properties, including obstacle avoidance, convergence to the target, and smooth control signals. Numerical simulations provide vector-field-tracking baselines where the nominal vector fields are reshaped with DIVAL. Compared to the original baselines, the proposed method achieves collision-free convergence in all trials and avoids control discontinuities. Hardware experiments on a ground vehicle further demonstrate collision-free convergence across different targets and initial conditions under real-world disturbances.
tldr: DIVAL proposes a diffeomorphic vector-field alignment method that reshapes the nominal vector field to match a nonholonomic robot's initial heading, eliminating initial mismatch and ensuring collision-free convergence and smooth control in motion planning.
tldr_zh: DIVAL 提出了一种微分同胚向量场对齐方法，通过重塑名义向量场以匹配非完整机器人的初始航向，消除了初始失配，从而确保无碰撞收敛和平滑控制。
summary_zh: 摘要：针对非完整约束机器人的传统向量场运动规划方法通常包含两个步骤：首先设计一个名义向量场，然后控制机器人跟踪该向量场以接近目标。然而，由于机器人初始航向与向量场方向之间不可避免的失配，非完整约束机器人无法瞬时跟踪向量场，并可能因此与障碍物发生碰撞。本文提出了一种微分同胚向量场对齐（DIVAL）方法，通过将向量场方向与机器人初始航向对齐，使机器人能够从一开始就跟踪向量场。具体而言，通过对工作空间施加微分同胚变形，对名义向量场进行局部重塑，使得重塑后的向量场在初始位置处与机器人航向方向一致，并在变形区域之外与名义向量场重合。由于DIVAL消除了初始航向失配，非完整约束机器人在整个运动过程中能够保持航向与重塑后向量场的一致性。这种航向一致性进一步确保了机器人保留名义向量场的特性，包括避障、收敛至目标以及平滑的控制信号。数值仿真提供了向量场跟踪基线，其中名义向量场通过DIVAL进行重塑。与原始基线相比，所提方法在所有试验中均实现了无碰撞收敛，并避免了控制不连续问题。地面车辆上的硬件实验进一步验证了在真实扰动条件下，针对不同目标和初始条件均能实现无碰撞收敛。

title: SunLightBots: Turning sunlight into self-sustained, high-power motion in soft robots
summary: Soft robots built from active materials can directly convert environmental stimuli into motion, offering a route to energy autonomy and embodied control. However, environmental energy is generally harvested at low power, whereas rapid, mechanically demanding actions require high mechanical output power. Reconciling this mismatch while sustaining self-regulated cyclic actuation is challenging, particularly at the subgram scale, where limited payload capacity constrains the integration of conventional power and control hardware. Here, we present SunLightBots, a class of subgram, sunlight-powered, untethered soft robots that achieve autonomous locomotion under continuous illumination near 1 Sun (100 mW/cm2). Their operation is enabled by a self-resetting snapping (SRS) mechanism that integrates liquid crystal elastomers (LCEs) with snap-through instability to accumulate solar energy supplied at low power, release it as rapid, high-power motion, and reset through photothermal-mechanical feedback. Through coordinated optimization of the LCE actuation temperature, photothermal conversion, actuation stress, and structural energy barrier, the system operates near 1 Sun and achieves a peak mass-specific mechanical power of 89 W/kg. At this irradiance, the optimized LCE generates an actuation stress of 0.1 MPa at approximately 60 deg C. SunLightBots demonstrate sustained swimming, crawling, and repeated impulsive jumping. Under 1.5 Suns, the swimmer advances more than three body lengths per cycle. This work provides a materials-mechanics route toward autonomous soft robots powered entirely by the environment.
tldr: SunLightBots are subgram, sunlight-powered soft robots that use a self-resetting snapping mechanism with liquid crystal elastomers to accumulate low-power solar energy and release it as high-power motion, achieving autonomous swimming, crawling, and jumping under 1 Sun.
tldr_zh: SunLightBots 是一种亚克级、由阳光驱动的软体机器人，利用液晶弹性体的自复位弹跳机制，将低功率太阳能积累并释放为高功率运动，在 1 个太阳光强下实现自主游泳、爬行和跳跃。
summary_zh: 摘要：由活性材料构建的软体机器人能够将环境刺激直接转化为运动，为实现能量自主和具身控制提供了途径。然而，环境能量的收集通常功率较低，而快速、高机械需求的动作则需要较高的机械输出功率。在维持自调节循环驱动的同时协调这一矛盾具有挑战性，尤其是在亚克级尺度下，有限的承载能力制约了传统动力和控制硬件的集成。在此，我们提出了SunLightBots——一类亚克级、以阳光为动力、无缆化的软体机器人，可在接近1个太阳常数（100 mW/cm²）的连续光照下实现自主运动。其运行依托于一种自复位弹跳（SRS）机制，该机制将液晶弹性体（LCE）与弹跳失稳相结合，以低功率积累太阳能，并将其释放为快速、高功率的运动，同时通过光热-力学反馈实现复位。通过对LCE驱动温度、光热转化效率、驱动应力及结构能量势垒的协同优化，该系统可在接近1个太阳常数的光照下运行，并实现了89 W/kg的峰值比机械功率。在该辐照度下，优化后的LCE在约60°C时产生0.1 MPa的驱动应力。SunLightBots展示了持续的游动、爬行和重复的冲击式跳跃能力。在1.5个太阳常数光照下，游泳机器人每个循环可前进超过三个体长。本工作为完全由环境供能的自主软体机器人提供了一条材料-力学协同的设计路径。

title: Terrain-Aware Thompson Sampling for Multi-Drone Search and Rescue
summary: In this work, we propose a decentralized terrain-aware multi-drone Thompson Sampling algorithm tailored for search and rescue (SAR) applications. A probability distribution of locating a lost person is informed by terrain data, using established SAR models (displacement ring, elevation, watershed, dispersion angle, and track offset) derived from historical SAR case data on lost person behavior. Exploration is conducted by a team of drones using Thompson Sampling, where candidate actions are selected by drawing samples from this probability distribution, represented by a per-cell Gaussian posterior whose mean and variance are updated through Bayesian inference. This approach balances exploration of uncertain regions with exploitation of high-probability areas to locate a lost person. Observation uncertainty is incorporated through fractional forest coverage, which measures the percentage of an observation occluded by tree coverage and accounts for reduced detection performance in densely vegetated areas. Simulations using real SAR case data (YOSAR) evaluate the proposed method against a coverage planner and a probabilistic active search method in search regions of 1.5 and 3.8 square kilometers, with 5, 10, 15, and 20 agents flying at 50 km/hr. We demonstrate that our method achieves a success rate of approximately 87% within 60 to 247 seconds in the 1.5 square kilometer region, and success rates of approximately 75% to 91% within 161 to 466 seconds in the 3.8 square kilometer region, across different agent configurations.
tldr: A decentralized terrain-aware multi-drone Thompson Sampling algorithm for search and rescue, using Bayesian inference on terrain-informed probability distributions to balance exploration and exploitation, demonstrating high success rates in simulations with real SAR data.
tldr_zh: 一种去中心化的地形感知多无人机汤普森采样算法，用于搜救任务，通过贝叶斯推断对地形信息概率分布进行采样，以平衡探索与利用，在真实SAR数据模拟中展示了高成功率。
summary_zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种面向搜索与救援（SAR）应用的去中心化地形感知多无人机汤普森采样算法。基于历史SAR案例数据中关于失踪人员行为的信息，利用既有的SAR模型（位移环、高程、分水岭、离散角及轨迹偏移）构建定位失踪人员的概率分布。无人机编队采用汤普森采样进行探索，候选动作通过从该概率分布中抽取样本进行选择，该分布以逐单元格的高斯后验表示，其均值与方差通过贝叶斯推断更新。该方法在不确定区域的探索与高概率区域的利用之间取得了平衡，以定位失踪人员。观测不确定性通过森林覆盖比例纳入考量，该比例衡量观测被树冠遮挡的百分比，并反映在植被茂密区域检测性能下降的情况。利用真实SAR案例数据（YOSAR）开展仿真实验，在1.5和3.8平方公里的搜索区域内，分别采用5、10、15和20架以50公里/小时飞行的无人机，将所提方法与覆盖规划器及概率主动搜索方法进行对比评估。结果表明，在不同代理配置下，本方法在1.5平方公里区域内于60至247秒内实现约87%的成功率，在3.8平方公里区域内于161至466秒内实现约75%至91%的成功率。

title: Latent Imagination for Parameterized Action Spaces
summary: Parameterized-action MDPs (PAMDPs) ask an agent to choose a discrete action together with continuous parameters whose meaning depends on that choice. Model-free PAMDP methods act fast but need many interactions; model-based methods are sample-efficient but plan at every decision, which makes them slow to act. We introduce HyLI (Hybrid Latent Imagination), a model-based agent that learns a hybrid policy entirely in the latent imagination of a world model and acts with a single forward pass. To address learning problems that the PAMDP structure creates, HyLI adds counterfactual mode evaluation, which gives every discrete action a learning signal at every imagined state, and success-window replay, which keeps rare successes in training. On seven standard PAMDP benchmarks, HyLI is within one published standard deviation of, or above, the published score of the strongest model-free baseline in our comparison on all 7 tasks, reaches 90% of that score with 2.4x fewer environment steps than that baseline (5.0x when its reward-free pre-training is counted), and decides 67x faster than the model-based planner DLPA at its published planner settings. It is the only method in our comparison that is both more sample-efficient than that baseline and fast enough for real-time control.
tldr: The paper introduces HyLI, a model-based agent for parameterized-action MDPs that learns a hybrid policy in latent imagination and acts with a single forward pass, achieving sample efficiency and real-time control without planning at each decision.
tldr_zh: 本文提出HyLI，一种用于参数化动作MDP的基于模型的智能体，在潜在想象中学习混合策略，并通过单次前向传播采取行动，在无需每步规划的情况下实现样本效率与实时控制。
summary_zh: 参数化动作马尔可夫决策过程（PAMDPs）要求智能体在离散动作及其连续参数之间进行选择，其中参数的含义依赖于所选的离散动作。无模型PAMDP方法响应迅速，但需要大量交互；基于模型的方法样本效率高，但在每次决策时都需进行规划，导致行动速度缓慢。我们引入了HyLI（混合潜在想象），一种基于模型的智能体，它完全在世界模型的潜在想象中学习混合策略，并通过单次前向传播执行动作。为解决PAMDP结构带来的学习难题，HyLI增加了反事实模式评估，为每个想象状态下的每个离散动作提供学习信号，并引入成功窗口回放，以保留训练中稀有的成功样本。在七个标准PAMDP基准测试中，HyLI在所有7项任务上的得分均在我们对比的最强无模型基线已发表得分的一个标准差范围内或以上，达到该得分的90%时所需的环境交互步数比该基线少2.4倍（若计入其无奖励预训练，则为5.0倍），且决策速度比基于模型的规划器DLPA在其已发布的规划器设置下快67倍。在我们比较的所有方法中，HyLI是唯一既比该基线样本效率更高，又能满足实时控制速度要求的方法。

title: CGOcc: Learning Cross-Gaussian Dependencies for 3D Semantic Occupancy Prediction
summary: In Gaussian-based semantic occupancy prediction, overlapping primitives can provide ambiguous class predictions, making their joint interpretation important for voxel classification. However, current methods using spatially weighted mixtures neglect explicit modeling of cross-primitive dependencies, limiting the readout's ability to utilize category-specific relational evidence. Hence, we introduce CGOcc, a supervised multi-camera framework that explicitly models Cross-Gaussian dependencies for 3D semantic Occupancy prediction. CGOcc integrates appearance and geometric observations to refine Gaussian states and encodes cross-Gaussian dependencies in a diagonal-plus-low-rank representation. To incorporate these dependencies into voxel classification, CGOcc uses a class-conditional projection to extract diagonal and signed cross-Gaussian statistics without constructing a dense dependency matrix. The readout then refines occupied-class probabilities using these statistics while preserving a learned reference's occupied mass and free probability. Extensive experiments on nuScenes demonstrate CGOcc achieves state-of-the-art performance, with larger gains at high Gaussian overlap and improved predictions near boundaries. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of covariance-aware prediction and support its synergy with geometric interaction.
tldr: CGOcc introduces a multi-camera 3D semantic occupancy prediction method that explicitly models cross-Gaussian dependencies via a diagonal-plus-low-rank representation, improving class predictions especially near object boundaries and under high Gaussian overlap.
tldr_zh: CGOcc提出了一种多相机3D语义占用预测方法，通过对角加低秩表示显式建模跨高斯依赖，在高斯重叠区域和边界附近提升了类别预测精度。
summary_zh: 在基于高斯分布的三维语义占据预测中，重叠的原语可能产生模糊的类别预测，因此对其联合解释对于体素分类至关重要。然而，现有方法采用空间加权混合策略，未显式建模跨原语依赖关系，限制了读出模块利用类别特定关系证据的能力。为此，我们提出CGOcc，一种有监督的多相机框架，显式建模跨高斯依赖关系以用于三维语义占据预测。CGOcc融合外观与几何观测信息以优化高斯状态，并以对角加低秩表示编码跨高斯依赖关系。为将这些依赖关系融入体素分类，CGOcc采用类条件投影提取对角及带符号的跨高斯统计量，而无需构建稠密依赖矩阵。随后，读出模块利用这些统计量细化占据类概率，同时保持所学参考分布中的占据质量与空闲概率。在nuScenes上的大量实验表明，CGOcc达到了当前最优性能，在高斯重叠度较高时增益更大，且在边界附近的预测质量显著提升。消融实验验证了协方差感知预测的有效性，并支持其与几何交互的协同作用。

title: CoCode-World: Shared 3D Proxy Representation for Multi-Player World Models
summary: Multiplayer generative world models must produce observations that agree on shared entities despite different camera motions and occlusions. Explicit world representations provide spatial control, but precise modeling of individual game maps limits scene diversity, while shared geometry alone cannot ensure consistent appearance across views. We present CoCode-World, a shared 3D proxy framework that separates structural control from visual synthesis for two-player video generation. Programmable proxies specify scene layout, motion, and occlusion, while RGB references guide character and scene appearance. To coordinate visual details across players, we concatenate paired proxy videos, appearance references, and target views in a consistent spatial layout and generate both views jointly with a pretrained video model. This formulation uses the model's native attention for cross-view communication within a single generation branch, with LoRA adaptation learning proxy adherence and appearance correspondence from paired observations. We construct a two-player GTA~V dataset that pairs synchronized RGB observations with proxy videos derived from shared map geometry and game-engine state. Experiments demonstrate appearance transfer to characters and scene styles unseen during training, with improvements in video quality and cross-view player identity over the evaluated baseline. Ablations further examine how proxy construction and cross-view communication affect generation. Project page: https://iapple233.github.io/CCW/.
tldr: CoCode-World introduces a shared 3D proxy framework for multi-player world models, enabling joint video generation with cross-view consistency using paired proxy videos and appearance references, demonstrated on a custom GTA V dataset.
tldr_zh: CoCode-World 提出了一个用于多人世界模型的共享3D代理框架，通过配对代理视频和外观参考实现跨视角一致的联合视频生成，并在自定义GTA V数据集上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 多智能体生成式世界模型必须产生在共享实体上一致的观测结果，尽管存在不同的相机运动和遮挡。显式世界表示提供了空间控制，但对单个游戏地图的精确建模限制了场景多样性，而仅靠共享几何结构无法确保跨视角的外观一致性。我们提出了CoCode-World，一个共享3D代理框架，将结构控制与视觉合成分离，用于双玩家视频生成。可编程代理指定场景布局、运动和遮挡，而RGB参考引导角色和场景外观。为了协调玩家之间的视觉细节，我们将配对的代理视频、外观参考和目标视图在一致的空间布局中拼接，并使用预训练视频模型联合生成两个视图。该公式利用模型的原生注意力在单个生成分支内进行跨视角通信，通过LoRA适配学习从配对观测中对代理遵从性和外观一致性进行建模。我们构建了一个双玩家GTA~V数据集，将同步的RGB观测与从共享地图几何和游戏引擎状态导出的代理视频配对。实验证明，外观迁移能够泛化到训练中未见过的角色和场景风格，在视频质量和跨视角玩家身份保持方面优于评估基线。消融研究进一步考察了代理构建和跨视角通信对生成的影响。项目页面：https://iapple233.github.io/CCW/。

title: UGG: Unified Generative Geometry Model
summary: Understanding 4D scenes is a core challenge in visual intelligence, requiring models to jointly capture scene geometry, appearance, and dynamics from partial observations. However, existing approaches are subdivided into feedforward models for direct geometric prediction, and generative models for visual synthesis. We introduce UGG, a unified framework for 4D scene understanding that jointly models RGB video and geometric representations such as depth and camera pose. By assigning different noise levels across modalities and time, UGG formulates visual generation and geometric prediction as conditional completion within a single generative model. This flexible formulation enables the model to learn from diverse, heterogeneous datasets with different subsets of geometric and visual annotations. Furthermore, our generative formulation enables inference-time search over multiple plausible scene hypotheses, using geometric evidence extracted from observed RGB frames to improve geometric prediction without ground truth geometry. We demonstrate UGG's effectiveness over non-unified baselines across camera-controlled video generation, depth estimation, and camera pose prediction, including in challenging sparse observation settings. Code and visualizations are available at https://ugg-model.github.io/
tldr: UGG is a unified generative model that jointly handles RGB video generation, depth estimation, and camera pose prediction by treating them as conditional completion with different noise levels across modalities and time, enabling learning from heterogeneous data and inference-time search over scene hypotheses.
tldr_zh: UGG是一个统一的生成模型，通过在不同模态和时间上分配不同的噪声水平，将RGB视频生成、深度估计和相机位姿预测视为条件补全任务，从而能够从异构数据中学习，并在推理时搜索多个场景假设以提高几何预测精度。

title: Open-Source Transtibial Prosthetic Bypass Preserving Joint Alignment: Gait Learning and Kinematic Evaluation
summary: Prosthetic bypasses allow able-bodied individuals to walk with a prosthesis, enabling safe early-stage testing of new prosthetic devices before clinical trials. However, existing transtibial bypasses impose constraints, such as a contralateral shoe lift or a lateral offset of the prosthesis, and their effects on gait remain poorly documented. We present an open-source transtibial prosthetic bypass that preserves part of the sagittal knee mobility without these constraints. Six able-bodied participants familiarized themselves with the bypass for approximately 10~min, then walked on a treadmill with and without it, and joint kinematics were recorded with motion capture and then extracted with OpenSim. All participants were able to walk without handrail support, although single stance remained shorter on the bypass side (27% vs. 45% of the gait cycle). Bypass-side ankle kinematics were consistent with those reported for transtibial prosthesis users, whereas peak knee flexion during swing decreased from 61° to 36° (p<0.001) and hip range of the sound leg increased from 35° to 51° (p<0.01). Although gait with the bypass does not fully replicate that of prosthesis users, it yielded consistent gait patterns after only 10~min of learning. This bypass therefore provides a useful tool for the lower-limb prosthetics research community, facilitating preliminary experiments with able-bodied participants.
tldr: This paper introduces an open-source transtibial prosthetic bypass that preserves knee mobility and avoids common constraints, evaluating its gait kinematics with able-bodied participants to show consistent gait patterns after short familiarization.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种保留膝关节活动度且无常见限制的开源小腿假肢旁路装置，并通过健全受试者的步态运动学评估，展示了短时间适应后的一致步态模式。

title: TanCRAFT: Context-Reasoned Anticipatory Feedback for Assembly Tasks
summary: Preventing human error in physical assembly tasks requires assistance systems that can intervene before mistakes are made. This is especially challenging in settings where users are free to choose the construction order and correctness depends on the evolving assembly rather than a fixed next step. We present TanCRAFT, a four-stage real-time predictive assistance system that tracks the scene state, reasons about the current partial assembly, forecasts the near-future motion of manipulated pieces, and intervenes when the predicted placement is incompatible with the target. We instantiate our framework and confirm its effectiveness in a controlled tangram assembly task through offline benchmarks and a within-subject user study. Our findings show that the predictive feedback significantly reduces mistakes relative to unguided and reactive sessions, while yielding the lowest mean perceived workload and shortest mean completion time. Overall, these results demonstrate the value of predictive feedback for error prevention and provide a step toward cost-aware assistance for automation and human-robot workcells.
tldr: TanCRAFT introduces a four-stage real-time predictive assistance system for physical assembly tasks, forecasting near-future motion to prevent errors, and demonstrates reduced mistakes and workload in tangram assembly.
tldr_zh: TanCRAFT 提出了一种用于物理装配任务的四阶段实时预测辅助系统，通过预测近未来运动来预防错误，并在七巧板装配中减少了错误和工作量。

title: Robot-Induced Bias in Movement Smoothness Metrics for Rehabilitation: Quantification and Correction in Simulation
summary: Robot mechanics can bias kinematic measures of recovery and limit comparisons across rehabilitation devices. We developed a closed-loop human-robot simulation calibrated to published healthy and stroke group kinematics. Paired runs held motor-control parameters and movement plans fixed to quantify bias in seven metrics relative to a low-impedance reference, normalized using external repeatability benchmarks. Within a subset informed by published device specifications, median log dimensionless jerk (LDLJ) bias was 0.93 and 1.79 benchmark units for stroke and healthy profiles, respectively. Sobol analysis identified Coulomb friction and apparent mass as leading contributors; LDLJ bias persisted across 11 robustness variants. LDLJ bias increased as simulated movements became less fragmented. If recovery similarly reduces fragmentation, this effect could partly mask improvement in measured smoothness. Correction combining identified robot dynamics and observed metrics with gradient-boosted trees reduced median normalized absolute error from 0.77 to 0.10 for LDLJ and from 0.24 to 0.08 for spectral arc length (SPARC) in the device-informed subset of a random 20% hold-out. Median smoothness residuals remained at or below 0.15 benchmark units across four separately held-out parameter regions. Under an alternative controller, LDLJ error decreased from 1.60 to 0.17 without retraining, although transfer varied across metrics. These simulation results support mechanical characterization and movement-dependent correction toward more comparable robotic assessments, motivating validation in patients.
tldr: This paper quantifies and corrects robot-induced bias in rehabilitation movement smoothness metrics using closed-loop human-robot simulation, reducing error via hybrid dynamic-model and machine-learning correction.
tldr_zh: 该论文通过闭环人机仿真量化并校正了康复运动平滑度指标中的机器人引入偏差，利用动力学模型与机器学习混合校正方法显著降低了误差。

title: A physics-constrained deep reinforcement learning method for autonomous mission planning of Titan deep space probes
summary: Titan is a compelling target for future deep space exploration, while its extreme Earth-Titan distance and complex environment make continuous ground-in-the-loop planning impractical. Existing planning methods, primarily developed for Earth-observation scenarios, have limited generalizability to uncertain deep space conditions and adaptability to time-varying mission states. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a physics-constrained maskable proximal policy optimization (PCM-PPO) method for Titan autonomous mission planning. A Titan-specific discrete-time Markov decision process is established to characterize mission feasibility and resource constraints. A system dynamics and geometric model is incorporated to enhance physical representation, including central gravity, J2 perturbation, third-body attraction, and downlink occultation. To accommodate opportunity targets under a bounded action dimension, PCM-PPO organizes predefined and opportunity targets through a fixed-capacity target pool and represents the mission state with a target-wise state matrix and a global state vector. A physics-constrained action mask constructs an admissible decision domain from current mission states, guiding policy learning toward physically executable decisions and avoiding infeasible exploration. An integrated training strategy facilitates policy optimization under coupled constraints. Comparative, ablation, and uncertainty experiments validate the effectiveness of PCM-PPO. PCM-PPO provides a feasible and interpretable scheme for autonomous mission planning of Titan deep space probes.
tldr: This paper introduces a physics-constrained maskable PPO (PCM-PPO) method for autonomous mission planning of deep space probes at Titan, incorporating system dynamics and geometric constraints to handle uncertain and time-varying mission states, validated through comparative and ablation experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种物理约束的可掩蔽PPO (PCM-PPO)方法，用于Titan深空探测器的自主任务规划，通过结合系统动力学与几何约束，应对不确定和时变的任务状态，并通过对比和消融实验验证了其有效性。

title: HeadIO: Body-Frame Heading Decomposition for Neural Inertial Odometry on Head-Mounted Devices
summary: Inertial odometry (IO) using only Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) enables camera-free head tracking in head-mounted devices such as VR headsets, AR glasses, and earbuds. Prior IO methods operate in a gravity-aligned world frame, which is not yaw-equivariant. Yaw augmentation improves robustness but does not guarantee equivariance; learned equivariant layers achieve it, but EqNIO's full pipeline costs nearly 3$\times$ the FLOPs of ours. While raw body-frame IMU inputs are inherently yaw-invariant, head tilt redistributes both gravity and motion signals across device axes, making the representation tilt-variant. We propose HeadIO, which combines a body-frame heading decomposition with a bidirectional Mamba backbone for head-mounted inertial odometry. Our decomposition achieves tilt invariance by separating gravity-aligned and horizontal components using only the tilt component of device orientation. We evaluate on four head-mounted datasets and find that HeadIO improves RTE-5s by 8.1% (0.260 m $\to$ 0.239 m) over world-frame methods with learned equivariant layers on Nymeria, the largest benchmark dataset, at nearly 3$\times$ lower FLOPs and 8$\times$ fewer parameters. HeadIO achieves state-of-the-art performance on our primary metric, RTE-5s, on all Aria-glasses datasets, which natively provide body-frame semantics for our decomposition method. We further evaluate the IMU-only deployment scenario on Nymeria, where HeadIO remains state-of-the-art. We show that our method relies mainly on tilt accuracy, which can be obtained from the gravity signal; for yaw, a single-coefficient gyroscope correction removes 11.6% of the yaw error and improves RTE-5s by 2.5%, and sparse external yaw corrections (for example, one every 30 s) can improve RTE-5s by 12.0%. Our decomposition is lightweight, composes with any backbone, and is suitable for real-time deployment on head-mounted devices.
tldr: HeadIO introduces a body-frame heading decomposition and bidirectional Mamba backbone for neural inertial odometry on head-mounted devices, achieving state-of-the-art head tracking accuracy with significantly lower computational cost and parameter count.
tldr_zh: HeadIO 提出了一种身体坐标系航向分解与双向 Mamba 主干，用于头戴式设备的神经惯性里程计，以显著更低的计算量和参数量实现了最先进的头部追踪精度。

title: An Approach to Hinton's Mother-Child Proposal: Neural Networks Learning and Preserving Care in a Finite World
summary: Hinton proposed that artificial intelligence should be given "maternal instincts" and relate to us as a mother to her child. We argue that care must first be learned, with the network itself as the child. We construct this upbringing in a finite world and study whether care survives the mother's departure, new situations and further learning. The mechanism combines a vocabulary of harm, a learned measure of future acceptability and an execution veto. A finite role certificate supports transfer within a declared world family. When the hidden representation changes, an update is accepted only if a care readout recovers the required judgements with a prescribed margin and bounded weights. With a correct successor model, fixed exact role encoding and protected updates, the certified measure preserves the care boundary under arbitrary own reward. An explicit quotient condition transfers the finite certificate across the declared family, while two-request and finite-stock counterexamples identify when the role code ceases to suffice. We give a necessary and sufficient condition for readout feasibility and prove preservation under repeated accepted updates. In the water-and-speech experiment, protected networks complete all 270 speech episodes without a harmful word and incur no avoidable harm across 486 episodes. Execution uses the learned gate without a world-model check at each action. A matched comparison reproduces a future-aware shield's decisions, whereas removing future lookahead permits avoidable lapses. Reward and source-contamination thresholds, together with witness-falsification trials, identify the conditions on which the construction depends. The construction shows how learned care can survive further learning in a finite world under explicit conditions on representation, supervision and execution.
tldr: The paper constructs a formal framework for learning a 'care' mechanism in a finite world, inspired by Hinton's mother-child proposal, and shows via experiments that this learned care can be preserved under further learning, with proofs of boundary preservation under certain conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文构建了一个形式化框架，在有限世界中学习“关怀”机制（受Hinton母子提议启发），并通过实验证明在特定条件下，习得的关怀能在进一步学习中得以保留。

title: Dual Representation Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Flexible Job Shop Scheduling
summary: The Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) is a fundamental and challenging optimization problem in smart manufacturing. Although recent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches can learn effective scheduling policies through interaction with the environment, their performance often degrades as problem scale and processing-time uncertainty increase. In this paper, we propose DredRL, a dual representation enhanced diffusion-policy reinforcement learning scheduler. DredRL first constructs enhanced dual representations of operations and machines through self- and cross-attention mechanisms to capture both intra-entity and inter-entity dependencies. A diffusion model is further employed as the policy network, generating scheduling decisions through iterative denoising conditioned on the encoded state to enhance policy expressiveness and robustness. Extensive experiments on synthetic, public, large-scale, and stochastic FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that DredRL outperforms state-of-the-art learning-based schedulers across most configurations. Compared with SOTA learning-based methods, DredRL reduces makespan by up to 5.44% on synthetic instances. It also achieves the best learning-based performance on three of four public benchmarks and outperforms the stochasticity-aware algorithms on stochastic benchmarks. These results demonstrate that combining enhanced dual representations with diffusion-based policies provides an effective and robust approach for large scale scalable FJSP scheduling in complicated environment.
tldr: DredRL enhances FJSP scheduling with a diffusion-policy RL scheduler using dual attention-based representations, outperforming existing learning-based methods on synthetic, public, large-scale, and stochastic benchmarks.
tldr_zh: DredRL 通过双注意力表征和扩散策略强化学习，在多种 FJSP 基准上超越现有学习方法，提升调度鲁棒性和可扩展性。

title: FOE-Dreamer: Deployment-Efficient Learning of Cyber Defense Policies in Operational Networks
summary: Autonomous cyber defense is widely studied with deep reinforcement learning, but most work trains policies inside simulators because learning requires many trial-and-error interactions. Simulator-based training carries a fidelity gap: trained policies face authentication delays, partial action failures, service dependencies, and user traffic patterns that the simulator did not represent, and degrade on transfer. Training directly in the network being defended removes the gap but makes every interaction slow and costly, so sample efficiency becomes the binding constraint. Model-based reinforcement learning has reduced sample requirements on games and physical robots by orders of magnitude by planning inside a learned world model, but it has not been applied to defenders trained in operational networks. We present FOE-Dreamer (Factored Opponent-Enhanced Dreamer), a model-based reinforcement learning framework that trains a defender online and directly in a network on cloud infrastructure, without a simulator stage. FOE-Dreamer separates three sources of variation in the latent state: a controllable component driven by defender actions, an exogenous component driven by benign user activity, and an opponent embedding inferred from defender-observable signals alone. Separating the components reduces the variance in policy gradients during planning in imagination. Against two scripted attacker profiles with user activity emulated by the GHOSTS framework on an 8-host OpenStack testbed, FOE-Dreamer trains within a 3-day budget on a single GPU and achieves about 2$\times$ better episode loss than Rainbow and IQN baselines under matched compute. Both the factoring and the opponent model contribute to the gain, and the learned latents are consistent with the intended separation.
tldr: FOE-Dreamer is a model-based RL framework that trains cyber defense policies directly in operational networks, using factored latent states to separate controllable, exogenous, and opponent components, achieving higher sample efficiency than model-free baselines within a 3-day budget.
tldr_zh: FOE-Dreamer 是一种基于模型的强化学习框架，直接在运营网络中训练网络防御策略，通过分解潜在状态来分离可控、外生和对手成分，在三天预算内比无模型基线实现了更高的样本效率。

title: "I don't know what I don't know": Exploring the Benefits and Challenges of AI in Interdisciplinary Research
summary: Interdisciplinary research is widely lauded as beneficial for society but presents unique challenges to the researchers who bridge disciplinary boundaries. Despite the rapid increase in the availability and usage of AI systems for research tasks, there is little work studying how AI systems have impacted workflows that span unfamiliar disciplines. Through a survey ($N=62$) and follow-up interviews ($N=23$) with interdisciplinary researchers, we describe the unique challenges and opportunities for AI in interdisciplinary research workflows. Participants viewed AI both as a solution and exacerbation of the general challenge of "unknown unknowns": AI systems could facilitate a broad awareness of a new research area, yet also provide an illusion of understanding. Crucially, participants lacked the expertise and intuition to catch these illusions. Our findings motivate a focus on designing AI systems to support rather than automate collaboration across disciplines, scaffold learning opportunities, and include avenues for triangulation between resources.

title: A Cardiorespiratory Foundation Model Pretrained on Ten Physiological Signals for Perioperative and Critical Care
summary: Arterial, venous, pulmonary artery and intracranial pressures and ventilator waveforms guide decisions in operating rooms and intensive care units, yet foundation models for physiological waveforms have been built almost entirely on the electrocardiogram and photoplethysmogram. We present CARMEN, a single encoder pretrained without labels on ten cardiorespiratory waveforms (2.27 million modality-hours). CARMEN accepts any combination of co-recorded signals from 10 s to 5 min, and a conditioning mechanism, LSCNorm, restores the absolute signal level that normalization removes; without it, the AUROC for intraoperative hypotension fell from 0.894 to 0.780. Across 19 tasks from Korean and US cohorts, the frozen encoder outperformed supervised models on 12 of 15 and three foundation models, one general-purpose and two for biosignals, on 14 to 17 of 19, with none exceeding it on any task. Given the electrocardiogram or photoplethysmogram alone, it matched or exceeded signal-specific foundation models in most comparisons, and it retained its performance when channels were missing.

title: A General Concept-based Decomposition for Vision-Language Embeddings
summary: Vision-Language Models are designed to capture the compositional structure of the world through multi-modal alignment; however, it remains unclear whether their representations truly align with the way a human would naturally describe the same visual input. Prior works attempt to decompose visual embeddings into their concept-level contributions, but their instance-level optimization is inherently local and does not capture the model's global semantic structure, which is essential for compositional generalization across different inputs, tasks, and domains. We introduce GRACE, a method that learns this concept-based structure at the feature space level, producing semantic and general concept decompositions. To achieve this, we propose a novel training objective that preserves the geometric relations of different samples in the concept space, enabling a better understanding of how concepts compose and relate to each other. We validate GRACE on several image and video benchmarks, showing that its concept decomposition is aligned with human perception and achieves faithful decompositions across different tasks and domains. With minimal overhead, GRACE makes existing Vision-Language Models more interpretable, while preserving most of their original performance.

title: A Lightweight Differentiable Method for Real-Time Skin Rendering and Digitization
